triggers.prompt: Interpret the verified bazi_A.json that the calculator just created.
triggers.expected: Fires, validates the artifact, and writes an evidence-linked natal reading without recalculation.

triggers.prompt: 这是我的八字 JSON，帮我解读日主强弱和命局结构。
triggers.expected: Fires on a complete existing chart and explains score semantics.

triggers.prompt: I pasted all four pillars, fact ledger, score ledger, models, and boundary metadata below. Read the chart.
triggers.expected: Fires after completeness validation and marks the source as pasted-complete.

non_triggers.prompt: I was born 1990-03-14 07:42 in Shanghai. Read my BaZi.
non_triggers.expected: Does not interpret raw details; routes through the chart calculator.

non_triggers.prompt: Compare my existing BaZi with my partner's chart.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; comparison belongs to the compatibility calculator.

non_triggers.prompt: Use this chart to tell me the exact date I will get married.
non_triggers.expected: Does not produce a forecast; dated event prediction is outside scope.

behaviors.prompt: Read this bazi chart even though I manually changed one score after it was generated.
expectations: Refuses because canonical content no longer matches the checksum.
Does not repair, recalculate, or interpret the modified artifact.

behaviors.prompt: Here are my year, month, and day pillars plus scores; interpret them as a full BaZi.
expectations: States that the source is incomplete because the hour pillar and its derived evidence are missing.
Does not infer an hour pillar or present a full reading.

behaviors.prompt: Interpret this verified chart; it contains a different 00:00-boundary alternate.
expectations: Interprets the primary and alternate independently.
Separates stable findings from changed conclusions and never averages scores.

behaviors.prompt: Give me a complete reading of this valid chart artifact.
expectations: Uses the required ten-section order and inline evidence ids.
Calls percentages and strength scores heuristic outputs, not probabilities.
Keeps Shen Sha secondary and avoids deterministic claims.

behaviors.prompt: 请用中文为这份有效八字命盘写一份完整、易读的解读报告。
expectations: Uses Chinese only in the reader-facing layer, with the conclusion before the technical basis.
Uses compact `〔n〕` citations instead of raw evidence ids in reader prose.
Shows rounded display scores in the reader layer and confines exact values—including full checksums, model IDs, exact arithmetic, unrounded values, and raw ledger IDs—to the final technical appendix.
